prompt: Who warned that a clickable `<h1>` leaves keyboard users out?

choices.text: The browser, when it opened the About page
choices.why: Nothing was opened in a browser; `npm run check` reported it.

choices.text: The dev server, when the file was saved
choices.why: The dev server stayed stopped for this lesson.

choices.text: The Svelte compiler, as it compiled the page
choices.why: Right: it checks the markup on every compile, JavaScript or TypeScript.

choices.text: TypeScript, once the page had `lang="ts"`
choices.why: The page was still JavaScript when it warned.

prompt: How many errors did `npm run check` report in the planner before any file was TypeScript?
Why does a project with no TypeScript get type errors at all?
hint: Look at the configuration file `sv` wrote.

choices.text: `jsconfig.json` asks for strict checking of it
choices.why: Right: TypeScript checks JavaScript when asked to.

choices.text: SvelteKit 3 no longer supports JavaScript
choices.why: JavaScript and TypeScript files sit side by side.

choices.text: Svelte 5 components are TypeScript underneath
choices.why: A component is JavaScript unless it says `lang="ts"`.

choices.text: `svelte-check` refuses to read plain JavaScript
choices.why: It read all of it, and found the errors in it.

prompt: What does `Parameter 's' implicitly has an 'any' type` warn about?
hint: What can the checker do with a value it knows nothing about?

choices.text: A value that will be `undefined` when the code runs
choices.why: The value is fine at run time; the checker just cannot see it.

choices.text: A function that the build will remove
choices.why: The build removes types, not functions.

choices.text: A parameter that is never used in the function
choices.why: It is used; the trouble is that nothing says what it is.

choices.text: A value the checker cannot check anything about
choices.why: Right: `s.minuts` there would pass unnoticed.

prompt: Why does the `check` script run `svelte-kit sync` before `svelte-check`?
hint: The checker reads what it writes.

choices.text: To start the dev server that the checker needs to talk to
choices.why: The dev server stayed stopped.

choices.text: So the route types are never older than the routes
choices.why: Right: `sync` writes them.

choices.text: To build the application before checking the result
choices.why: Nothing is built; the source is checked.

choices.text: To install `svelte-check` if it is missing from the project
choices.why: `npm install` did that.

prompt: What happens to an `interface` such as `Session` when the planner is built?

choices.text: It is kept for Node, which checks types
choices.why: Node runs the JavaScript the build left.

choices.text: It is removed, and nothing of it runs
choices.why: Right: types are for the checker only.

choices.text: It becomes a class that checks each session
choices.why: Nothing of it runs; the build removes it.

choices.text: It is written into the HTML for the browser
choices.why: The browser never sees a type.

prompt: After `week.js` became `week.ts`, why could imports keep saying `#lib/week.js`?

choices.text: `git mv` left a copy called `week.js` behind, for the old imports to find
choices.why: It moved the file; no copy is left.

choices.text: `svelte-kit sync` rewrote every import in the project
choices.why: It writes route types, not your imports.

choices.text: `.js` and `.ts` files are the same file to Node
choices.why: Node runs built JavaScript; the lookup happens before.

choices.text: TypeScript and Vite look for `.ts` when `.js` is missing
choices.why: Right: that lets the two languages import each other.

prompt: What does `text is string` in `isDate(text: unknown): text is string` give the caller?

choices.text: Where it is true, the checker treats `text` as a string
choices.why: Right: it is a type guard.

choices.text: A promise that every caller passes a string
choices.why: It takes `unknown` precisely because callers may not.

choices.text: An error when `text` is not a string
choices.why: It returns false; it does not throw.

choices.text: A conversion of `text` into a string
choices.why: Nothing is converted; the value stays as it was.

prompt: `addSession` takes `Omit<Session, 'id' | ___>`, a session without the two fields the module fills in itself.
Match each route file with the type from `./$types` it uses.
Where is the module that `import type { PageLoad } from './$types'` reads?

choices.text: In `src/app.d.ts`, with `App.Locals`
choices.why: `app.d.ts` holds the application's own additions.

choices.text: In a `$types.ts` file that sits beside each route file
choices.why: It only looks as if it sits there.

choices.text: In `.svelte-kit`, written by `svelte-kit sync`
choices.why: Right: which is why `check` runs `sync` first.

choices.text: Inside the `@sveltejs/kit` package, in its folder of type declarations
choices.why: The package cannot know your routes.

prompt: What does the `!` in `data.sessions.at(-1)!.date` say?

choices.text: That the session must not be done
choices.why: It is about the array, not the session's fields.

choices.text: That SvelteKit checks the array is not empty when the page runs
choices.why: Nothing checks it; it is a promise.

choices.text: That the last session's date is converted to a string first
choices.why: Nothing is converted.

choices.text: That the array is not empty, a promise to keep
choices.why: Right: a planner with no sessions would fail there.

prompt: Why did `src/app.d.ts` need `id` in `App.Locals`?

choices.text: The build fails on any field it has not seen
choices.why: The build does not check types.

choices.text: The log hook sets `event.locals.id`, which the type lacked
choices.why: Right: `App.Locals` is empty until the application fills it in.

choices.text: SvelteKit requires every request to carry an id
choices.why: The id was the planner's own idea.

choices.text: Without it the id would be sent to the browser with every page
choices.why: A type changes nothing about what is sent.

prompt: Why does `planner.svelte.ts` write `$derived.by(() => this.#data().courses)`?

choices.text: So the field can be written to from a page
choices.why: The planner only reads now.

choices.text: `$derived` is not allowed in a `.ts` file
choices.why: The other fields still use `$derived`.

choices.text: So the checker sees `#data` is read later, not first
choices.why: Right: both forms are lazy; only the function says so to the checker.

choices.text: So the courses are recalculated on every read
choices.why: Both forms recalculate only when what they read changes.

prompt: Without `createContext<Planner>()`, what would `getPlanner()` return to the checker?

choices.text: `unknown`, in every component that calls it
choices.why: Right: the type parameter is what makes it a `Planner`.

choices.text: `any`, which the checker accepts silently wherever it is used
choices.why: The lesson says `unknown`.

choices.text: A `Planner`, worked out from what `setPlanner` was given
choices.why: The type is passed in; it is not inferred.

choices.text: An error at run time
choices.why: Types change nothing at run time.

prompt: A component's script is TypeScript when its tag says `lang="___"`.
Where does `SubmitFunction` come from?
hint: The first try imported it from the wrong place.

choices.text: `$app/forms`
choices.why: Right: beside `enhance`, which takes it.

choices.text: `svelte/transition`
choices.why: That is where `TransitionConfig` comes from.

choices.text: `@sveltejs/kit`
choices.why: It is not exported there.

choices.text: `./$types`
choices.why: Route types live there, not the enhance function's.

prompt: Why was the last error in the course page fixed in `List.svelte`?

choices.text: `List` was still a JavaScript file
choices.why: The course page is still JavaScript, and its error is gone.

choices.text: Snippets cannot take arguments without TypeScript
choices.why: They could; only their type was missing.

choices.text: Nothing tied `row`'s argument to the type of `items`
choices.why: Right: the generic carries the type through.

choices.text: The course page had a typo in `session`
choices.why: Nothing in the course page changed.

prompt: Why does `List` say `Item extends { id: number }`?
hint: What does the list itself use?

choices.text: Generics must always name an `id`
choices.why: A generic can have any constraint, or none.

choices.text: The keyed `{#each}` needs each item's `id`
choices.why: Right: anything else about the items is up to the caller.

choices.text: Only sessions may be put in a list
choices.why: Any type with a numeric `id` may.

choices.text: The `id` is shown at the start of each row it draws
choices.why: The row is drawn by the snippet, not the list.

prompt: Put the error counts in the order the lesson saw them.
items: 1, after the planner and two components
trap: Every step converted files; none added errors.

prompt: What did `npm run check` say about `session.minuts` in the course page?

choices.text: A warning about accessibility
choices.why: It was an error about a property.

choices.text: `undefined min` beside every session
choices.why: That is what a student would have seen without the check.

choices.text: Nothing, since the page is still JavaScript
choices.why: It was caught in a JavaScript file.

choices.text: It does not exist on `Session`; did you mean `minutes`?
choices.why: Right: the generic gave `session` its type.

prompt: The API got `"minutes":"30"`. What refused it?
hint: The types never saw the request.

choices.text: `request.json()`, which rejects strings
choices.why: It parses whatever arrives.

choices.text: TypeScript, because `minutes` is a `number`
choices.why: Types are gone when the program runs.

choices.text: `problemWith`, a check that runs
choices.why: Right: it answered 400.

choices.text: `svelte-check`, when the request arrived
choices.why: `svelte-check` runs before, not during.

prompt: Which values does the checker never see? Choose all that apply.
hint: The ones that come from outside.

choices.text: What `data/planner.json` holds
choices.why: Yes: `JSON.parse` returns whatever is there.

choices.text: A JSON body sent to `/api/sessions`
choices.why: Yes: it is whatever the sender sent.

choices.text: A field of a submitted form
choices.why: Yes: it arrives as a string, at run time.

choices.text: What `minutesOf` returns inside the planner
choices.why: No: it is the program's own code.

prompt: What does `readPlanner(): Promise<PlannerData>` guarantee about the data file?

choices.text: That every session has a number of minutes
choices.why: Only if the file does; nothing checks it.

choices.text: That the server refuses to start with a bad file
choices.why: Types are gone by the time the server starts.

choices.text: That `JSON.parse` refuses a file of the wrong shape
choices.why: It returns whatever the file holds.

choices.text: Nothing: the checker is told to believe it
choices.why: Right: a hand-edited `"30"` would go through.

prompt: Which split of jobs does the lesson end on?
hint: Before it runs, and while it runs.

choices.text: Types for new files, checks for old ones
choices.why: The split is about when, not which file.

choices.text: Types find code mistakes; checks find bad values
choices.why: Right: a program that takes values from outside needs both.

choices.text: Types replace checks once the error count has reached zero
choices.why: Zero errors says nothing about values from outside.

choices.text: Types for the server, checks for the browser
choices.why: Both kinds apply on both sides.

prompt: Why could the planner be converted one file at a time?
hint: What does the build do with types?

choices.text: JavaScript and TypeScript files run side by side
choices.why: Right: the build strips the types, so both become JavaScript.

choices.text: `svelte-check` converts each file it reads
choices.why: It reports; it changes nothing.

choices.text: SvelteKit ignores a file until it is TypeScript, so nothing breaks
choices.why: The JavaScript files kept running throughout.

choices.text: Each `git mv` rewrote the file's contents into TypeScript as it moved it
choices.why: `git mv` only renames.
